navigator_case_plan_md:
# Re-entry Navigation Case Plan: Eddie Ballenger

## 1. Participant Overview
- **Name:** Eddie Ballenger
- **Location:** Spartanburg / Upstate SC
- **Current Status:** Enrolled in First Shift, currently in community/transitional housing. On active probation.
- **Strengths:** Strong family support (mother/siblings), positive relationship with fiancee, stable housing (loves his current placement), recognizes the value of education/employment, highly motivated to avoid re-incarceration.
- **Vulnerabilities:** Diagnosed learning disability, suspended driver's license, impulsivity, externalizes blame for past offenses, active antisocial peers.

## 2. Core Criminogenic Targets & CBT Interventions
- **Target 1: Antisocial Cognition (Blame Shifting & Impulsivity)**
  - *Intervention:* Utilize cognitive restructuring worksheets. Focus on the "Thinking Check-In." When Eddie expresses that he "had no choice," utilize Modeling Neutrality (Standard 1.5). Ask: *"Looking back with the wisdom you have now, what is one other way that situation could have played out?"*
- **Target 2: Antisocial Peers**
  - *Intervention:* Role-play boundary setting. Eddie noted a close friend is still engaged in crime. Discuss the "people, places, and things" that act as triggers without condemning the friend directly.
- **Target 3: Education/Employment Deficits**
  - *Intervention:* Eddie has a 10th-grade education and a learning disability. Ensure all case management materials are highly visual, verbally discussed, and paced appropriately. Connect him with GED tutoring that accommodates learning disabilities.

## 3. Barrier Removal & Stabilization
- **Transportation:** The suspended license is an immediate barrier to sustainable employment. Refer to the Upstate Fatherhood Initiative to untangle the suspension and set up public transit via Greenlink in the interim.
- **Financial Health:** Eddie relies on a Social Security check and worries about bills. Connect him to United Ministries for matched savings and financial coaching to reduce economic anxiety.

## 4. Next Steps for Navigator
- [ ] Complete referral for Upstate Fatherhood Initiative (License).
- [ ] Map out Greenlink Transit routes from his housing to prospective Upstate employers.
- [ ] Introduce the CBT "Stop and Think" module in the next 1-on-1 session.
- [ ] Coordinate with GED providers to ensure accommodations for his learning disability.

# My Fresh Start Action & Resource Guide: Eddie Ballenger

Welcome to your personalized roadmap, Eddie! You’ve shown a lot of strength by taking accountability for your future, maintaining your housing, and building strong relationships with your family and fiancee. You already know that you want a life free from the justice system. This guide is designed to help you tackle the hurdles in your way—like getting your license back, finishing your GED, and landing a great career.

## 🌟 Your Immediate Action Steps & Resources

### 1. Driver's License & Legal Support
Getting your license back is key to your independence.
- **Upstate Fatherhood Initiative**
  - **Services:** Driver's license restoration, job readiness, child support help.
  - **Contact:** (864) 244-9333 | 201 E Broad St, Suite 200, Greenville, SC
  - **Link:** [Visit Website](https://scfathersandfamilies.com) | [Get Directions](https://maps.google.com/?q=201+E+Broad+St,+Greenville,+SC+29601)

### 2. Transportation (While working on your license)
- **Greenlink Transit**
  - **Services:** Reliable bus transit across the Upstate area to get you to work and classes.
  - **Contact:** (864) 467-5000
  - **Link:** [Visit Website](https://greenvillesc.gov/150/Greenlink-Transit)

### 3. Education & Job Coaching
- **United Ministries**
  - **Services:** Job training, life coaching, and support for your financial goals so you don't have to stress about bills.
  - **Contact:** (864) 232-6463 | 606 Pendleton St, Greenville, SC
  - **Link:** [Visit Website](https://united-ministries.com) | [Get Directions](https://maps.google.com/?q=606+Pendleton+St,+Greenville,+SC+29601)

---

## 💼 Targeted Fair-Chance Job Matches
These employers in the Upstate region are actively hiring and are known for giving people a genuine second chance. They value hard work over perfect backgrounds.

**1. Upstate Precision Manufacturing**
- **Role:** CNC Machine Operator Trainee / Material Handler
- **Location:** Greenville / Greer, SC
- **Pay:** $18.50 – $23.00 / hr
- **Shift:** 1st & 2nd Shifts Available
- **Why it fits:** They offer on-the-job machine training, which is perfect while you are finishing your GED. They are a dedicated fair-chance partner.
- **Next Step:** [Apply Online / View Careers Page](https://www.indeed.com/jobs?q=manufacturing+machine+operator&l=Greenville%2C+SC)

**2. Foothills Structural Steel & Welding**
- **Role:** Welder Apprentice / Structural Steel Helper
- **Location:** Greenville (Donaldson Center), SC
- **Pay:** $19.50 – $26.00 / hr
- **Shift:** 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM (M–F)
- **Why it fits:** If you like working with your hands, they offer an apprenticeship path and are willing to train individuals seeking career growth in skilled trades.
- **Next Step:** [Apply Online / View Careers Page](https://www.indeed.com/jobs?q=structural+welder&l=Greenville%2C+SC)

---

## 📅 Your 4-Week Milestone Checklist
- [ ] **Week 1:** Call the Upstate Fatherhood Initiative to schedule an appointment about your suspended license. Download the Greenlink transit app on your phone.
- [ ] **Week 2:** Meet with your Navigator to discuss GED classes that fit your learning style. Review the "Stop and Think" decision-making exercise.
- [ ] **Week 3:** Submit applications to Upstate Precision Manufacturing and Foothills Structural Steel using the links above.
- [ ] **Week 4:** Prepare for interviews with your Navigator and map out your bus routes to your new potential job sites.

*"You can't go back and change the beginning, but you can start where you are and change the ending." You got this, Eddie!*
